description: Asks workers on the current harness the same question and returns labeled takes. Default roster is the current model on every slot. Nobody writes project files. Optional --agents N (default 3, min 2, max 5). Apply when the user invokes opinion or /opinion, wants other takes, or says auto-pick. Use execute when this chat should do the work after the takes. Use deep-deliberation for checkpointed decisions. Use blinded-eval to A/B a skill change.
